question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who brings a legal action against someone in court.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Plaintiff"** refers to one who brings a legal action against someone in court. (मुकदमा करने वाला)

 
 
• **Example: **The **plaintiff **filed a lawsuit against the corporation for breach of contract.
 
 
 
• **"Sanctimonious"** means making a show of being morally superior to other people. (पाखंडी)
 
 
• **Example: **His **sanctimonious **attitude made him unpopular among his peers.
 
 
 
• **"Numismatic"** pertains to the study or collection of coins, paper currency, and medals.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a **numismatic **collection that includes rare coins from ancient Rome.
 
 
 
• **"Pragmatist"** means a person who is practical and focused on reaching a goal. (व्यावहारिक)
 
 
• **Example: **As a **pragmatist**, he always finds the most efficient way to get things done.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sanctimonious **(पाखंडी): Making a show of being morally superior to other people.

 
 
• **Example:** His **sanctimonious **attitude made him unpopular among his peers.
 
 
 
• **Numismatic**: Pertaining to the study or collection of coins, paper currency, and medals.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a **numismatic **collection that includes rare coins from ancient Rome.
 
 
 
• **Pragmatist** (व्यावहारिक): A person who is practical and focused on reaching a goal.
 
 
• **Example:** As a **pragmatist**, he always finds the most efficient way to get things done.
